description: The tempo of a score in beats per minute: one value for all of it (tempo), or changes at beats (changes; one or the other). A change at beat 0 sets the opening tempo; ramp true glides from the change before and arrives at this one's tempo on its beat. A stretch of n beats at tempo T lasts 60 × n / T seconds, so a change of tempo can put any moment of the picture exactly on a beat. Notes and notes regions keep their beats, so their times in seconds move; audio regions keep their length in seconds unless they were placed with fit_beats. Returns the new score_id (edit that one next), the score's length, and where each bar now starts in seconds and frames.
